label: bastar-dhokra/process/core-before-and-after-sem
title: The dhokra core before and after sem leaves
description: Two swatches of the black soil core of a dhokra figure, before and after it is rubbed green with sem leaves. Place it beside the leaf-paste stage.

spec.description: The black soil core before and after it is rubbed with sem leaves
spec.title: u0002

u0002.text: Sem leaves turn the core green.

u0003.text: Crushed sem leaves are rubbed over the dry model until it turns green, so the next soil does not stick to it.

C055.text: Crushed leaves of the sem or country bean creeper are rubbed over the dry model until it turns green, to keep the next soil from sticking to it.

quotes.quote: Fresh and 'semi' or 'sem' or country bean creeper leaves are brought, crushed by rubbing them between both palms till a green liquid oozes out.
all over the model until the models looks totally green. This is to prevent the soil from sticking to the model
The purpose of applying green liquid to model is to prevent the soil from sticking to the model.
